Arjun Menon | Kochi | arjun.menon@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Software Engineer, Backwater Labs, Kochi (2021 - present)

- Gave tech talks at Kochi JavaScript meetups about building webhook consumers.
- Maintain open-source sample apps on GitHub that show how to call our API.
- Recorded short video walkthroughs and technical demos for new partner integrations.

SKILLS
JavaScript, Node.js, TypeScript, Git

BTech Computer Science, Cochin University of Science and Technology, 2021
